Class ResteasyHttpServletResponse

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.ServletResponseWrapper
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponseWrapper
org.jboss.resteasy.core.servlet.ResteasyHttpServletResponse
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse, jakarta.servlet.ServletResponse
public class ResteasyHttpServletResponse extends jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponseWrapper
Wraps an HttpServletResponse to know when the output stream has been written to.

An instance holds the output stream of a single response, so it must only be used for one request.

Author:
James R. Perkins
